protocol.context_selection: First native training-size seed for each cue/upper-branch key/ball combination
protocol.forced_path: Action2 from x1 east to fork; final target0(top) or1(bottom) from visible objects
protocol.objective: Final-observation seven-action cross entropy; full sequence gradients
protocol.batch: All four unique balanced native contexts in fixed canonical order at every update
protocol.evaluation: Final checkpoint only; reuse the exact four selected training seeds at each size
protocol.state_ablation: reset_all clears GRU/store each step; reset_store clears only matrix before each write
protocol.selection: No early stopping, checkpoint selection, budget extension or accuracy-based retuning
protocol.scope: Supervised choice learnability and forced-path length transfer, not gameplay or RL

claim: Four-context supervised final-turn learnability and forced-path length transfer only
